title: style: reformat the int4 tail-block slice #1104 left unformatted
head: squad/roy-fmt-repair-1104
body:
`cargo fmt --all -- --check` fails on `main` at 9b7a45860 (#1104), in `crates/onnx-runtime-ep-cpu/src/kernels/matmul_nbits.rs:6239`. Every open PR's `Rust quality` job therefore fails for a reason unrelated to the PR.

This is the third time (see #1089, #1102): the merge queue does not re-run formatting against the merge result, so an individually-green PR can still land unformatted `main`.

Pure `cargo fmt -p onnx-runtime-ep-cpu` output, two lines, no behaviour change.
